description: Convert an Excel workbook to CSV in your browser: every sheet, quoted properly, with dates as Excel shows them. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

data.description: The Excel workbook (.xlsx or .xlsm), base64-encoded; a data: URL prefix is stripped if present. The old binary .xls format is refused with error 'xls'. Up to 50 MB once decoded.

delimiter.description: The field separator. semicolon is what Excel uses in locales whose decimal point is a comma (German, French, Danish…). Defaults to comma.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale for decimal and thousands separators and month names when values is shown, e.g. de-DE gives 1.234,50. Defaults to en-US.

sheets.description: Names of the sheets (tabs) to convert, in workbook order. Leave out to convert every visible sheet; naming a hidden sheet includes it.

skipHidden.description: Leave out rows and columns that are hidden in Excel. Defaults to false, which keeps them, as Excel's own Save as CSV does.

values.description: shown writes each cell as Excel displays it (dates, currency, percentages, separators of `locale`); plain writes the stored value: numbers with a full stop and no thousands separators, dates as ISO 8601. Defaults to shown.

name: excel_to_csv
title: Excel to CSV
